integrity: The arbitrary-family claim is supported by a direct star-cluster proof. Finite enumeration is reported only as a reproducibility check and is not promoted to an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns ordinary matching complexes of quadrilateral books. The finite verifier covers only \(n=1\) through \(n=7\); arbitrary \(n\) is proved analytically. Literature searches may miss results published under different edge-amalgamation terminology.
title: A three-page collapse threshold for quadrilateral book matching complexes
